dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 03, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
PHILLIES SWEEP NATIONALS BEHIND HARPERS 24TH HOMER

In a 6-3 win over the Washington Nationals, Bryce Harper continued his hot streak with his 24th home run of the season. The Phillies' victory marked their second straight win. Meanwhile, Derek Hill led the Nationals with a home run, four RBIs, and three hits.

The St. Louis Cardinals exploded for 13 runs in their 13-7 win over the New York Yankees. Alec Burleson hit three home runs, driving in six runs, and the Cardinals' pitching staff held the Yankees to seven runs. 

The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3. Spencer Horwitz had three RBIs, while Garrett Stallings earned a strong 3.0 innings on the mound with four strikeouts.

Across the MLB, Jung Hoo Lee hit two home runs and drove in three runs for the San Francisco Giants in their 5-1 win over the Texas Rangers. Logan Webb earned his first win of the season with six strong innings.
